_comment: Photo classification ground truth fixtures. Each record matches PhotoClassificationSample: photo_path (str, relative to repo root), expected_room_type (RoomType str value), expected_confidence_min (float 0-1). Real photos from input_data/houses/ikea_showroom/photos/. Only 3 images are available in this dataset: two clean JPEG kitchen shots and one PNG browser screenshot of the IKEA showroom page. All are classified as 'kitchen'; no other room types are present in this input set. The screenshot uses a lower confidence threshold (0.60) because on-screen renders may have lower visual fidelity than direct photography.
